reviews.text: Excellent service, they advise you with awareness.

Their patience, kindness, and excellent treatment are spectacular, not only with us but also with our pets, who are like our children. They always keep you informed, very clearly, give you options, and if necessary, they take care of referring you to hospitals. They make sure you feel at ease, and we always feel heard. From reception to the medical staff, hats off to them. They're the best in the neighborhood 🫶🏼 Thank you, ladies, I wouldn't trade them for anything.
They have had all the empathy I needed at all times. They refer you to the hospital if necessary.
Excellent in every way. My Paco is in love!

Highly recommended! We've been taking our dog there forever and we're delighted with Dolors and the care we receive, both for ourselves and our pet. She always looks after them and treats them as if they were her own, she's very involved and empathetic with everyone. We're very, very happy with her and hope she stays at this center for a long time.
The vet is great, very friendly service.

Since I started taking my dog ​​Barney to Dolors, I have peace of mind knowing he's in the best hands. Dolors not only does excellent work, she truly cares for the furry friends we bring her; she lives and breathes their care as if they were her own. She always explains everything that's available, what can be done, the options... she really makes us all feel special as clients. And you won't find that kind of quality anywhere else. And Laura, the receptionist, always greets you with a smile and pleasant conversation, making the wait or the time after your visit interesting and enjoyable. I sincerely believe the personal attention you both provide is impeccable. A 10 out of 10 for both of you, thank you for being who you are ♥️

Dolors is a great veterinarian! The treatment she receives is always professional, close and friendly. You can tell how much she loves animals by the way she handles them, carefully and calmly. Purrins is delighted!

Dolors is the best vet in the world!! From day one, she's treated your furry friend with complete dedication, passion, and lots of love. She's attentive to everything, even checking on your pet's progress if they're undergoing treatment.
We're so lucky to have found her, and I can't stop recommending her. Many of us in the neighborhood already go to her!
Very unprofessional.
The milloc centre 😍 …
The best vet in all of Barcelona! I take my two little ones here and I'm more than satisfied with the professionals. Top-notch service and friendliness!
Great people and best professionals...don't hesitate...animal passion
She has been taking care of my baby girl, Luna, for 6 years. She's brown or dark blonde. Thank you for being so professional.
The best vets in the world. They help and advise, and are super friendly. They've known Yaki's name since day one. How lucky we are!

I've been taking my pets to the vet since I was little. We had two Siamese cats, from kittens until they were rainbow cats. Then I had a Bobtail, and it was the same.

Now I have a Sphynx and a European Shorthair.
Both Laura and Dolors are exceptional people; they love our pets and treat them with so much love.
I will continue to take my pets there forever. Thank you so much for being the way you are, for being there, and for giving your best.

I'm not giving it a zero because I can't. It was a while ago, but I went there with my dog ​​because another dog had torn off half her ear, and this awful animal who called herself a veterinarian wanted to pour alcohol on the open wound while my little one was terrified. I left immediately... they should shut that place down. And then she asked me what I wanted her to do. Excuse me? You're a veterinarian? Pathetic.
The morning girls are so sweet
One of the best veterinary centers you can find. The veterinarian, Dolors, is close and very professional. We don't live in Barcelona, ​​but that's where we take our dog. Highly recommended.
The best veterinarian in Barcelona! We felt very comfortable taking our pet to Dolors. Thank you for your professionalism and for taking such good care of our dog!

The best veterinary center I've ever taken my pets to. I want to thank Dolors for all the care she gave my cat Cava and for the advice she gave us about her treatment. Cava is now at rest. Thank you all for your understanding and the love you showed us. Thank you from the bottom of my heart ❤️😻 …
